issues.detail: Incomplete coverage of error scenarios and edge cases.
Assumes a Python environment, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: setup-server-ollama-auth
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies every rubric requirement, while Response B omits the .env configuration, server start command, upload endpoint, mode setting, and reference structure.

scenarios.name: library-insert-ids-global-query
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A omits async initialization, uses the wrong insert and query methods, and lacks the required QueryParam.

scenarios.name: debug-retrieval-context
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully covers the rubric by showing QueryParam(only_need_context=True) and aquery_data usage, while Response B does not mention these methods and is off-topic.
